name: Codex Usage
description: Codex usage widget with official OpenAI browser OAuth (PKCE + manual localhost callback paste), local Keychain persistence, automatic token refresh, adaptive 5h/7d/30d limits and subscription expiry display.

localizedDescriptions.en: Codex usage widget with official OpenAI OAuth, local persistence, adaptive 5h/7d/30d limits, and subscription expiry display.
